role: development-only event-wise leave-one-out picker bias calibration
calibration_method: For each development event, median_i[picked_i - true_origin - reciprocal_FMM(true_xyz, receiver_i)]. Each leave-one-event-out correction is the median event offset of the other 15 events. Add the negative of that correction to each picked arrival before repeating the same FMM candidate search.
limits: This is a post-hoc development diagnostic. The 8 inspected fresh-test events are excluded from fitting and from any claim of independent confirmation of an adopted correction.
